name: Tent pegs
summary: Three steel tent pegs standing point-down with a small wooden mallet beside them; for camping and tent-pitching scenes.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 560 px wide (hero size); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: tap = the mallet head lifts and drops as if driving a peg in

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the mallet then sits on the left)
